title: Fate Reforged Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Daghatar the Adamant
entities.description: A warrior who speaks of victories protecting generations and of family as a weapon.

entities.name: Mytha
entities.description: A Temur shaman who speaks of shaping ice.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir to which the shaman Mytha belongs.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A being whose whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to his primal battle with Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Led by Ugin's whispered summons to witness the battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A being who fought Ugin in a primal battle that sealed Tarkir's fate.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The world whose fate was sealed by the battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
entities.description: A warrior who urges greeting death with sword in hand.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon whose limitless hunger could consume all of Tarkir.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: A speaker who warns of Atarka's hunger.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragon that has shattered countless weapons meant to slay her.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragon whom Shu Yun battled.

entities.name: Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest
entities.description: A fighter who battled Ojutai and realized his learning had only begun.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragon described as pure, sweeping death.

events.summary: Ugin's summons lead Sarkhan Vol to witness the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas, which seals Tarkir's fate.
events.quote: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.
When I battled Ojutai, I realized my learning had only begun.

relations.quote: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.
